exercises.name: Push-ups
instructions: Start in plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulders
Lower your body until chest nearly touches the floor
Push back up to starting position
Keep your body in a straight line throughout

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squats
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart
Lower your body by bending knees and pushing hips back
Go down until thighs are parallel to floor
Push through heels to return to standing

exercises.name: Pull-ups
instructions: Hang from pull-up bar with overhand grip
Pull your body up until chin is over the bar
Lower yourself down with control
Keep core engaged throughout

exercises.name: Plank
instructions: Start in forearm plank position
Keep body in straight line from head to heels
Engage core and hold position
Breathe normally while holding

exercises.name: Lunges
instructions: Stand with feet together
Step forward and lower hips
Front knee should be at 90 degrees
Push back to starting position

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: Start in plank position
Alternate driving knees toward chest
Keep hips level and core engaged
Move quickly in a controlled manner

exercises.name: Burpees
instructions: Start standing with feet shoulder-width apart
Squat down and place hands on floor
Jump back to plank position
Jump feet back to squat and jump up

exercises.name: Dips
instructions: Use parallel bars or dip station
Lower body by bending elbows
Go down until elbows are at 90 degrees
Push back up to starting position
exercises.description: Bodyweight upper body exercise using parallel bars or bench

exercises.name: Glute Bridges
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent and feet flat
Push through heels and lift hips up
Squeeze glutes at the top
Lower back down with control

exercises.name: Leg Raises
instructions: Lie on back with legs extended
Keep legs straight and raise to 90 degrees
Lower legs without touching floor
Repeat for desired reps

exercises.name: Handstand Hold
instructions: Position hands shoulder-width apart
Kick legs up into handstand position
Keep body straight and core tight
Hold for desired duration
exercises.description: Advanced bodyweight shoulder and core exercise

exercises.name: Push-up Variations
instructions: Choose variation: diamond, wide grip, or explosive
Maintain proper form throughout
Control the descent and ascent
Adjust difficulty as needed

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Start standing with feet together
Jump while spreading feet and raising arms
Jump back to starting position
Maintain steady rhythm

exercises.name: High Knees
instructions: Run in place while lifting knees to chest height
Move arms in running motion
Maintain high intensity
Keep core engaged
exercises.description: Cardio exercise focusing on leg elevation

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench with dumbbell in each hand
Press dumbbells up from chest level
Lower with control to chest level
Keep core engaged and feet planted

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rows
instructions: Bend over with dumbbell in each hand
Pull dumbbells to your ribs
Squeeze shoulder blades together
Lower with control

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squats
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulders or sides
Perform squat movement
Keep chest up and knees tracking over toes
Drive through heels to stand
exercises.description: Lower body exercise with added weight

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height
Press dumbbells overhead
Keep core engaged for stability
Lower with control

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curls
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at sides
Curl dumbbells up toward shoulders
Keep elbows stationary at sides
Lower with control

exercises.name: Dumbbell Tricep Extensions
instructions: Hold dumbbell overhead with both hands
Lower dumbbell behind head by bending elbows
Keep elbows stationary and pointing up
Extend back to starting position

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at sides
Raise dumbbells to shoulder height
Keep slight bend in elbows
Lower with control

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lunges
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides
Step forward and lower hips
Push back to starting position
Alternate legs for each rep

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Position barbell on upper back
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart
Squat down by pushing hips back and bending knees
Drive through heels to return to standing

exercises.name: Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, bar over mid-foot
Bend at hips and knees to grasp bar
Lift by extending hips and knees simultaneously
Keep bar close to body throughout movement

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench with barbell at chest height
Press barbell upward
Lower with control to chest
Keep feet planted and core engaged

exercises.name: Barbell Rows
instructions: Bend over with barbell at knee height
Pull barbell to chest
Squeeze shoulder blades together
Lower with control

exercises.name: Barbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Hold barbell at shoulder height
Press barbell overhead
Keep core and legs tight for stability
Lower with control

exercises.name: Running
instructions: Start with light jog or walk
Maintain steady pace
Land on midfoot, not heel
Keep posture upright and relaxed

exercises.name: Jump Rope
instructions: Hold rope handles at hip level
Jump on balls of feet
Keep jumps low and quick
Maintain steady rhythm

exercises.name: Stationary Bike
instructions: Adjust seat and handlebars for comfort
Pedal at steady pace
Adjust resistance as desired
Maintain upright posture

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Sit with feet in footrests
Grab handle and extend legs while pulling handle
Return to starting position with control
Maintain rhythm and breathing

exercises.name: Treadmill Walking
instructions: Start at comfortable pace
Maintain steady walking speed
Keep posture upright
Can be done while watching TV or reading

exercises.name: Sprints
instructions: Start with 30 seconds of maximum effort
Follow with rest or walk period
Repeat for desired intervals
Allow for recovery between sprints

exercises.name: Child's Pose
instructions: Kneel on floor with big toes touching
Sit back on heels and fold forward
Extend arms in front or alongside body
Hold and breathe deeply

exercises.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
instructions: Start on hands and knees
Arch back and lift head (cow)
Round back and tuck chin (cat)
Alternate between positions smoothly

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart
Hinge at hips and reach toward toes
Keep knees slightly bent
Hold and breathe deeply

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Perform a lunge position
Gently press hips forward
Feel stretch in front of rear leg
Hold and breathe

exercises.name: Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Bring one arm across body
Use opposite hand to pull arm toward chest
Keep shoulder blade pulled back
Hold and breathe

exercises.name: Downward Dog
instructions: Start in plank position
Push hips up and back
Form inverted V shape
Hold and breathe for desired duration

exercises.name: Quad Stretch
instructions: Stand on one leg
Pull other foot toward glutes
Keep knees together
Hold and breathe

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding ab roller
Engage core and roll forward while maintaining plank position
Roll out as far as you can control
Use core to pull yourself back to starting position
Keep back flat and hips level throughout
exercises.description: Advanced core exercise using ab roller

exercises.name: Kneeling Ab Rollout
instructions: Kneel on floor with ab roller in front
Grasp roller and engage core
Roll forward slowly maintaining neutral spine
Roll as far as comfortable
Pull back to kneeling position using core strength
exercises.description: Kneeling variation of ab wheel rollout

exercises.name: Aerobic Stepping
instructions: Stand facing the stepper platform
Step up with one foot, then the other
Step down in reverse order
Maintain upright posture and steady pace
Keep arms moving naturally or use them for balance
exercises.description: Full-body cardio exercise on aerobic stepper

exercises.name: Step Ups
instructions: Stand facing stepper with hands on hips or arms swinging
Step up with one leg explosively
Drive knee up at the top
Step back down with control
Alternate legs in continuous motion
exercises.description: Lower body cardio exercise with intensity

exercises.name: High Step
instructions: Stand beside or facing stepper
Drive knee up to chest height onto stepper
Alternate rapidly between legs
Maintain high intensity throughout
Engage core for stability and power
exercises.description: High-intensity cardio using stepper with high knee drive

exercises.name: Wall Push-ups
instructions: Stand facing a wall about 2 feet away
Place hands on wall at shoulder height
Lean in and bend elbows to touch chest toward wall
Push back to starting position
Maintain body in straight line from head to heels
exercises.description: Beginner-friendly push-up progression using a wall

exercises.name: Incline Push-ups
instructions: Place hands on elevated surface like chair or bench
Body should form straight line from head to heels
Lower body until chest nearly touches the elevated surface
Push back up to starting position
Keep core engaged throughout movement
exercises.description: Push-up variation with hands elevated on a chair or bench

exercises.name: Decline Push-ups
instructions: Place feet on elevated surface like chair or bench
Hands on floor in push-up position
Body should form straight line
Lower body until chest nearly touches floor
Push back up, maintaining control
exercises.description: Advanced push-up with feet elevated on a chair or bench

exercises.name: Pike Push-ups
instructions: Start in downward dog yoga position
Hips raised high, forming inverted V shape
Bend elbows and lower head toward floor between hands
Push back to starting position
Maintain pike position throughout

exercises.name: Hand Release Push-ups
instructions: Start in standard push-up position
Lower body to floor
Release hands briefly from floor
Place hands back and explosively push up
Control descent and repeat
exercises.description: Explosive push-up variation where hands leave the ground

exercises.name: Chin-ups
instructions: Hang from pull-up bar with underhand grip
Pull your body up until chin is over the bar
Lower yourself down with control
Keep core engaged throughout
Avoid swinging or kipping

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-ups
instructions: Loop assistance band over pull-up bar
Place knee or foot in band for support
Pull your body up with band assistance
Lower with control
Gradually reduce band assistance as you progress

exercises.name: Scapular Pull-ups
instructions: Hang from pull-up bar with straight arms
Pull shoulder blades down and back without bending elbows
Lift body just a few inches
Return to starting position
This is foundational for pull-up strength
exercises.description: Pull-up progression focusing on scapular engagement

exercises.name: Jump Squats
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart
Lower into squat position
Explosively jump up, extending legs fully
Land softly and immediately descend into next squat
Keep chest up and core engaged
exercises.description: Explosive lower body exercise combining strength and cardio

exercises.name: Box Jumps
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or elevated surface
Swing arms back and bend knees
Explosively jump up onto the box
Land softly with bent knees
Step down carefully and repeat
exercises.description: Explosive power exercise jumping onto an elevated surface

exercises.name: Calf Raises
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart
Rise up onto balls of feet
Hold at the top for a second
Lower heels back down with control
Keep body upright throughout

exercises.name: Wall Sits
instructions: Place back against a wall
Slide down until knees are at 90 degrees
Thighs should be parallel to ground
Keep back flat against wall
Hold position for desired time
exercises.description: Isometric lower body exercise using a wall

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridges
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent, feet flat
Extend one leg straight
Push through planted foot to lift hips
Squeeze glutes at the top
Lower with control and alternate legs
exercises.description: Unilateral glute exercise for strength and balance

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squats
instructions: Stand facing away from a chair or bench
Place one foot on elevated surface behind you
Step forward with front leg
Lower hips until front thigh is parallel to ground
Push through front foot to return to standing
exercises.description: Unilateral lower body exercise with rear foot elevated on a chair

exercises.name: Side Lunges
instructions: Stand with feet together
Step to the side and lower hips
Keep the stepping leg bent and other leg straight
Push back to center
Alternate sides
exercises.description: Lateral lower body lunge for quad and glute work

exercises.name: Reverse Lunges
instructions: Stand with feet together
Step backward and lower hips
Back knee should nearly touch floor
Front knee at 90 degrees
Push through front foot to return to standing

exercises.name: Side Planks
instructions: Lie on side with body in straight line
Support body on forearm and outer foot
Keep hips lifted and core engaged
Hold position for desired time
Repeat on other side

exercises.name: Dead Bugs
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent, feet flat
Raise arms toward ceiling and lift knees to 90 degrees
Slowly extend opposite arm and leg away from body
Return to starting position
Alternate sides in controlled manner
exercises.description: Core stability exercise performed lying on back

exercises.name: Hollow Body Holds
instructions: Lie on back with arms extended overhead
Press lower back into floor and engage core
Shoulders should be pulled away from ears
Body should form hollow shape
Hold position while maintaining tension
exercises.description: Foundational core position for gymnastics movements

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent, feet off ground
Place hands behind head
Bring opposite elbow toward opposite knee
Rotate torso while bringing knee toward elbow
Alternate sides in pedaling motion
exercises.description: Core exercise with rotational component for obliques

exercises.name: Russian Twists
instructions: Sit on floor with knees bent, feet elevated
Lean back slightly while maintaining upright torso
Rotate torso side to side
Touch floor beside body with each rotation
Keep core engaged throughout

exercises.name: Superman Holds
instructions: Lie face down on floor with arms extended overhead
Engage core and glutes
Lift arms and legs off ground simultaneously
Hold position while maintaining tension
Lower with control and rest

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Taps
instructions: Start in push-up plank position
Tap left shoulder with right hand
Return hand to floor
Tap right shoulder with left hand
Alternate in controlled manner without rotating hips
exercises.description: Dynamic core exercise combining plank with shoulder engagement

exercises.name: Bear Crawls
instructions: Start on hands and feet in tabletop position
Keep hips low and parallel to shoulders
Move opposite arm and leg forward
Move in controlled manner across floor
Maintain core engagement throughout
exercises.description: Full-body functional movement for strength and cardio

exercises.name: Crab Walks
instructions: Sit on floor with hands behind you, knees bent
Lift hips off ground
Walk forward by moving hands and feet
Keep hips lifted throughout movement
Maintain upright torso position
exercises.description: Reverse functional movement strengthening shoulders and core

exercises.name: Inchworms
instructions: Stand with feet together
Bend forward and place hands on floor
Walk hands forward to plank position
Walk feet toward hands, keeping legs straight
Return to standing and repeat
exercises.description: Full-body functional movement combining stretching and strength

exercises.name: Farmer Carries
instructions: Hold dumbbells or weights at sides
Stand tall with shoulders back
Walk forward while maintaining upright posture
Keep core engaged throughout
Distance can be measured in time or distance
exercises.description: Functional movement building grip strength and core stability

exercises.name: Goblet Squats
instructions: Hold dumbbell or kettlebell vertically at chest
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart
Lower into squat position
Knees track over toes, chest stays upright
Drive through heels to return to standing
exercises.description: Lower body squat holding weight at chest

exercises.name: Turkish Get-ups
instructions: Lie on back holding kettlebell on one side
Press kettlebell to arm-extended position
Sit up while keeping kettlebell extended
Reverse the movement to return to starting position
Perform entire sequence in one fluid motion
exercises.description: Complex full-body movement combining strength and mobility

exercises.name: Shadowboxing
instructions: Stand in boxing stance with feet shoulder-width apart
Throw punches at imaginary opponent
Move around in footwork patterns
Alternate between different punch combinations
Maintain continuous movement and breathing
exercises.description: Cardio exercise mimicking boxing movements without equipment

exercises.name: Face Pulls
instructions: Attach resistance band at face height to door anchor
Hold band with both hands and step back for tension
Pull band toward face, separating hands to sides
Focus on squeezing shoulder blades together
Return to starting position with control
exercises.description: Shoulder health exercise using resistance band

exercises.name: Band Pull-aparts
instructions: Hold resistance band at chest height with arms extended
Band should have slight tension
Pull band apart by separating hands to sides
Squeeze shoulder blades together at maximum contraction
Return to center with control
exercises.description: Upper back and shoulder health exercise with resistance band

exercises.name: Band Chest Press
instructions: Anchor resistance band to door at chest height
Face away from door and hold band handles
Press hands forward, extending arms fully
Maintain upright posture
Return to chest with control

exercises.name: Band Overhead Press
instructions: Stand on resistance band or secure it at feet
Hold band handles at shoulder height
Press hands overhead against resistance
Keep core engaged for stability
Lower with control to shoulder height
exercises.description: Shoulder pressing exercise using resistance band

exercises.name: Band Rows
instructions: Anchor resistance band at chest height or stand on it
Hold band handles with arms extended
Pull hands toward torso against resistance
Squeeze shoulder blades together at contraction
Return to extended position with control
